name: SBI Leasing Services Co.,Ltd.
summary: SBI Leasing Services Co., Ltd. arranges and sells investment funds in the operating lease business, mainly for aircraft and ships, through Aircraft, General Aviation and Principal Investment segments. It also works in areas such as crypto-assets, investment, asset management, financial services and next generation businesses. Incorporated in 2017 with its base in Minato, Japan, it is a subsidiary of SBI Holdings, Inc.
